properties.note: Hand-authored approximate polygons for 8 Brooklyn neighborhoods. Built WITHOUT access to the live NYC NTA (Neighborhood Tabulation Area) dataset -- outbound network access to data.cityofnewyork.us/opendata.arcgis.com was blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy (403 on CONNECT) during this work package, and no cached NTA shapefile was available locally. Vertices are approximate street-corner coordinates from general geographic knowledge of NYC, NOT digitized from an authoritative parcel/NTA source. Precision is roughly city-block level (order ~50-150m), not survey grade. See docs/WP2-geo.md for the street-boundary rationale behind every vertex and every hand-tuning decision (especially the Fort Greene / Clinton Hill and Cobble Hill / Carroll Gardens splits). REPLACE with real NTA-derived geometry once network access is available (see docs/WP2-geo.md 'How to redo this with live data').

properties.name: Greenpoint
properties.boundary_note: Newtown Creek (N/E, Queens border) - East River (W) - Metropolitan Ave / McCarren Park north edge (S, border with Williamsburg) - McGuinness Blvd (E, border with East Williamsburg).

properties.name: Williamsburg
properties.boundary_note: Metropolitan Ave / McCarren Park (N, border with Greenpoint) - Flushing Ave corridor (E/S, border with East Williamsburg/Bed-Stuy) - Flushing Ave / Navy Yard (S, border with Fort Greene) - East River (W).

properties.name: Fort Greene
properties.boundary_note: HAND-TUNED. Flushing Ave / Navy Yard (N, border with Williamsburg) - Washington Ave (E, border with Clinton Hill -- see docs for why this line was chosen over the NTA cutline) - Atlantic Ave (S, border with Boerum Hill/Prospect Heights) - Flatbush Ave / Navy St / BQE (W, border with Downtown Brooklyn).

properties.name: Clinton Hill
properties.boundary_note: HAND-TUNED. Flushing Ave (N, border with Williamsburg) - Classon Ave (E, border with Bed-Stuy) - Grand Ave / Atlantic Ave (S, border with Crown Heights/Prospect Heights) - Washington Ave (W, border with Fort Greene -- shared hand-tuned line, see docs).

properties.name: Prospect Heights
properties.boundary_note: Atlantic Ave (N, border with Fort Greene) - Grand Ave / Washington Ave (E, border with Clinton Hill/Crown Heights) - Eastern Parkway / Grand Army Plaza (S, border with Crown Heights/Park Slope) - Flatbush Ave / 4th Ave (W, border with Boerum Hill/Park Slope).

properties.name: Park Slope
properties.boundary_note: Grand Army Plaza / Flatbush Ave (N/NE, border with Prospect Heights) - Prospect Park West (E, border with Prospect Park) - 15th St / Prospect Expressway (S, border with Windsor Terrace) - 4th Ave (W, border with Gowanus).

properties.name: Carroll Gardens
properties.boundary_note: HAND-TUNED. Degraw St (N, border with Cobble Hill) - Court St / Smith St (E, border with Boerum Hill/Gowanus/Park Slope) - 9th St / Hamilton Ave (S, border with Red Hook/Gowanus) - Hicks St / BQE (W, border with Columbia St Waterfront/Red Hook). Extracted from the merged NTA 'Carroll Gardens-Columbia Street-Red Hook' polygon by cutting along these streets.

properties.name: Cobble Hill
properties.boundary_note: HAND-TUNED. Atlantic Ave (N, border with Brooklyn Heights) - Court St (E, border with Boerum Hill) - Degraw St (S, border with Carroll Gardens -- shared hand-tuned line) - Hicks St / BQE (W, border with Brooklyn Heights/Red Hook). Extracted from the merged NTA 'Brooklyn Heights-Cobble Hill' polygon by cutting along Atlantic Ave / Degraw St.
